about: What the topic scanner (npm run topics:scan) looks at for this channel. youtubeQueries = what this channel's audience types into a search box; the scanner takes the videos uploaded this week, sorted by views, and compares each with its channel's usual views. creator = what the creator has, so a topic is only picked when it can be made.
creator: Makes faceless videos in TikMaker (their own AI video editor) with screen recordings and an AI voice. Has a Mac, Claude Code (subscription), ChatGPT and Gemini (free), ElevenLabs. Can try a tool, run a test or a comparison and show the result. No studio, no paid tools beyond these.
